Subject: Request: marketplace listing concession & co-sell pricing for Amplify pilot

Hi Stephanie,

Thanks again for the demo last week — team is excited. We’re preparing a private offer in AWS Marketplace to get procurement to buy easily, but procurement asked whether Redwood can provide a listing concession and a short-term introductory price for the first 12 months of the pilot.

Quick context: Amplify HealthCo is doing a 9-month pilot across 3 hospitals, expected seat-based consumption ~120k tokens/month initially, with a renewal decision after month 9. Procurement prefers a single PO via Marketplace private offer. They asked for a 25% off list on the Marketplace listing and an additional co-sell credit to match their negotiated budget.

I’ve attached a short Opportunity Summary and the procurement contact details. Can you let me know how Redwood handles exceptions like this and what the approval path looks like? We’d like to get something in place before our procurement review on Mar 4.

Attachments: Amplify_Opportunity_Summary.pdf (1 page)

Best,
Alex

Quick read: Amplify is strategic (healthcare, possibility to scale across region), but initial consumption is modest. My recommendation: approve a temporary listing concession of 20% off list for the first 12 months, coupled with a co-sell credit of up to 10% of ACV (paid as marketplace incentive). Rationale: 20% gives procurement a visible “listed” discount while preserving unit economics; 10% co-sell helps close but stays within incentives budget for small pilot deals.

I attached a short comparison I ran between typical concessions we’ve approved (last 6 mos) and the proposed ask — see pricing-comparison.xlsx. If finance is comfortable, we can present these terms to Alex and provide a private offer template.

-Ben

Thanks — reviewed Ben’s comps. A couple of notes from deal desk / finance:
- Approveable range without exec sign-off: up to 18% listing concession + up to 5% marketplace/co-sell credit for pilot deals under $200k first-year ARR.
- For requests above that (or above 18% listing), we need VP Sales or CRO sign-off and a short write-up of strategic rationale (reference to expansion opportunity + customer logo value).
- Need the expected 12-month ARR number from Amplify to confirm whether this falls inside the standard approval band.

If the team wants the 20%/10% Ben proposed, we can escalate to VP Sales (I’ll route to Hannah if you confirm). Otherwise we can offer 18%/5% as a finance-approved provisional.

-Rishi
Director, Revenue Operations & Finance

Alex / Sara — thanks for the patience. Quick update and proposed path so you can take to procurement on Thu: 

What we can provisionally approve (subject to DocuSign and final ACV confirmation):
- Marketplace listing concession: 18% off list for months 0–12 (applies to the public listing price shown in AWS Marketplace).
- Co-sell/marketplace credit: 5% of the first-year ACV (credited via Marketplace incentive program).

If Amplify confirms expected 12-month ARR > $200k and still needs deeper concession (20% listing + 10% credit), we will escalate to VP Sales for an exception. If you’d like that path, let us know ASAP and provide the ARR projection.

Next steps:
1) I’m attaching the private-offer SOW and the pricing comparison we used.
2) Please confirm the expected 12-month ARR and sign the DocuSign link below to lock in the private offer pricing.
3) Once signed we’ll publish the private offer in AWS Marketplace and route the marketplace credit.

DocuSign: https://www.docusign.com/Signing?doc=AMPLY-5342-offer
Attachments: Amplify_SOW_v3.pdf, pricing-comparison.xlsx

Happy to jump on a 20-min call if procurement wants to review the private-offer flow before Thu.

Best,
